description.zh: 主播ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位。
description.en: The anchor ID. Only letters and digits are supported. Maximum length: 36 characters.

description.zh: 主播昵称，支持中英文，最大长度32位。
description.en: The nickname of the anchor. Chinese and English characters are supported. Maximum length: 32 characters.

description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 直播封面，支持图片地址链接格式，最大长度256位。
description.en: The cover image URL of the live room. Maximum length: 256 characters.

description.zh: 是否开启连麦功能，默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the co-streaming feature. Default value: false.

description.zh: 拓展字段，按需传递，需要额外记录的直播属性。最大长度4096位。
description.en: The extension field. Pass this parameter as needed to record additional live room properties. Maximum length: 4,096 characters.

description.zh: 直播公告，支持中英文，最大长度256位。
description.en: The announcement of the live room. Chinese and English characters are supported. Maximum length: 256 characters.

description.zh: 直播标题，支持中英文，最大长度32位。
description.en: The title of the live room. Chinese and English characters are supported. Maximum length: 32 characters.

description.zh: 操作人ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位。
description.en: The ID of the operator. Only letters and digits are supported. Maximum length: 36 characters.
